rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\nhostsvc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\nhstw32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\nldrw32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\rmserverconsolemediator.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\nhostsvc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\nhstw32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\nldrw32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\rmserverconsolemediator.exe' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Potential Netop Remote Control (aka Impero Connect) RMM Tool Process Activity

author: Daniel Koifman (Koifsec)
description: Detects potential processes activity of Komari RMM tool
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\komari-windows-386.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\komari-windows-amd64.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\komari-windows-arm64.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\komari-agent.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\komari-windows-386.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\komari-windows-amd64.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\komari-windows-arm64.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\komari-agent.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='komari-windows-386.exe' OR OriginalFileName='komari-windows-amd64.exe' OR OriginalFileName='komari-windows-arm64.exe' OR OriginalFileName='komari-agent.exe'))))
title: Komari RMM Process Activity

author: Phyo Paing Htun
description: This rule can detects additional remote access tools, often masquerading as legitimate software, to maintain persistence and access to compromised systems. In one observed incident, adversaries installed the Simple Help Remote Monitoring and Management (RMM) tool after gaining initial access through ScreenConnect.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\ProgramData\\JWrapper-Remote Access\\JWAppsSharedConfig\\restricted\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\ProgramData\\JWrapper-Remote Access\\JWAppsSharedConfig\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\SimpleService.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\serviceconfig.xml' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Malicious Remote Access Execution Via Simple Help RMM Software
